# Exeter Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Exeter. Fireplace installation covers planning and fitting gas fireplaces, including direct-vent units and freestanding stoves, with appropriate fuel and vent connections.

Email: contact@exeterheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://exeterheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Exeter, Seaforth, Crediton, Dashwood, Brucefield, Centralia. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
